terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Mwasalat Learning Platform.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By creating an account or using the Mwasalat Learning Platform ("the Platform"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not register or use the Platform.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility & Accounts
sections.body: The Platform is available to external learners who register for access to Mwasalat's public training courses. You must provide accurate information when registering and are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential. You may not share your account with anyone else.

sections.heading: 3. Learner Conduct & Academic Integrity
sections.body: You agree to complete assignments, quizzes, and assessments honestly and in your own words. Sharing quiz answers, impersonating another learner, or attempting to bypass attendance or check-in requirements may result in suspension of your account.

sections.heading: 4. Course Content & Intellectual Property
sections.body: All course materials — videos, documents, quizzes, and assignments — remain the property of Mwasalat and its instructors. You may access this content for your own learning during your enrollment, but may not copy, redistribute, or reuse it outside the Platform without written permission.

sections.heading: 5. Certificates
sections.body: Certificates of completion are issued once you meet a course's attendance, assessment, and review requirements. A certificate confirms course completion only; it does not represent professional certification unless explicitly stated on the course page.

sections.heading: 6. Payments & Refunds
sections.body: External learners paying for course access agree to the price shown at checkout. Payments are processed through our third-party payment provider; refund eligibility, if any, is stated on the relevant course page or communicated by the Academy team before purchase.

sections.heading: 7. Live Classes & Recordings
sections.body: Live sessions may be recorded for learners who could not attend and for quality purposes. By joining a live class, you consent to being recorded. Recordings are only shared with learners enrolled in that course.

sections.heading: 8. Suspension & Termination
sections.body: Mwasalat may suspend or terminate your account for violating these Terms, for non-payment of fees where applicable, or if your employment or enrollment status changes (for example, a dropped enrollment). You will lose access to course content and progress upon termination, except that certificates already issued remain valid.

sections.heading: 9. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The Platform is provided "as is." Mwasalat is not liable for interruptions in access caused by factors outside its reasonable control, such as internet outages or third-party service downtime.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the Platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be directed to the Academy support team through the Platform.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information we collect on the Mwasalat Learning Platform and how we use it.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and password (stored securely, never in plain text). As you use the Platform we also record your course enrollments, progress, quiz and assignment results, attendance and check-ins, certificates earned, and messages you send through course chat or discussion boards. For external learners, payment details are collected and processed directly by our payment provider — we do not store full card numbers.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information to give you access to your courses, track your progress and eligibility for certificates, notify you about deadlines and announcements, respond to support requests, and generate attendance and performance reports for the administrators and instructors responsible for your training.

sections.heading: 3. Third-Party Services
sections.body: The Platform relies on a small number of trusted service providers: Cloudinary to host uploaded files and videos, Zoom for live classes, a payment gateway for external learner payments, and an email service to deliver verification codes and notifications. These providers only receive the information needed to perform their function.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your account and learning records for as long as your account is active, and for a reasonable period afterward to support certificate verification, dispute resolution, and legal or audit requirements.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of your personal data, ask us to correct inaccurate information, or request account deletion by contacting the Academy support team. Some records, such as issued certificates, may be retained for verification purposes even after account deletion.

sections.heading: 6. Data Security
sections.body: Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. We use encrypted connections (HTTPS) and access controls so that only authorized administrators and instructors can view learner records relevant to their role.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies & Local Storage
sections.body: The Platform uses your browser's local storage to keep you signed in and to remember preferences such as language and daily fee-reminder acknowledgements. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.

sections.heading: 8. Who This Policy Applies To
sections.body: The Platform is intended for working professionals and adult learners. It is not directed at children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as the Platform evolves. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated effective date.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact the Academy support team through the Platform.
